// Object-level authorization for this feature (TS §12.4: `policy.ts` exports `can<Action>(actor, resource)`).
import type { Actor } from "../../platform/actor.ts";
import type { LoanRow } from "./loans.repository.ts";

/** Only an admin sees who has an item on loan (the borrower-privacy invariant, PRD §3.5/5.16). */
export const canViewBorrowers = (actor: Actor): boolean => actor.user.role === "admin";

/** A member returns only their own loan; an admin returns any loan. */
export const canReturn = (actor: Actor, loan: LoanRow): boolean => actor.user.role === "admin" || loan.user_id === actor.user.id;
